primary.title: India Inc’s earnings rebound faces fresh test as commodity costs rise
primary.summary: A sharp turnaround in oil marketing companies and strong gains in select sectors have lifted Q2 earnings, but higher input costs and uneven pricing power could test India Inc’s margins in the coming quarters.
